name: services/slips/to_be_answered
description: This method allows you to browse through the list of all questions which are waiting to be answered by the user.

arguments.name: langpref
arguments.description:
A code of the preferred language ("pl" or "en"). It may influence the
	order and other display properties of the returned objects.

arguments.name: unanswered_before
arguments.description:
Datetime string. By default, the list will contain only unanswered
	questions. With this parameter you may include some recently answered
	questions (answered after the specified date). This might be helpful
	for review.

arguments.name: answer_filter
arguments.description:
If unanswered_before is given you can restrict answered questions
	to answers starting with the given filter.

arguments.name: num
arguments.description:
The number of search results to return on a single page.
	The maximum allowed value is 100.

arguments.name: start
arguments.description:
The index of the first matching search result that is to be included
	in the response (zero-based).

arguments.name: order_by
arguments.description:
Pipe-separated list of fields to order by. Each field reference might be preceded with a dash to indicate descending order. Currently allowed fields to order by:

  • slip.date_created,
  • slip.client,
  • question.question.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary of the following structure:

  • items - a list of matching clips. Each item is a clip object, as returned by the slip method. It will contain all the fields requested with the fields parameter (only id by default).

  • next_page - boolean, indicates if there is a next page of results for this query.
  • total - integer, a total number of matched items; if the number of matched items is huge, then USOS API may return an approximate count (especially if start is equal to 0).
